name: light
description: Hierarki Praxis - versi ringan 2 layer sub-agent + staf 1 + master + staf 2. Setiap agent boleh memakai model berbeda.

models._comment: Map opsional nama-agent -> model. Prioritas: field 'model' di agent > models[nama] > default_model > fallback server.

_comment_reasoning: KONFIG THINKING TRACE (OpenRouter). 'default_reasoning' berlaku ke SEMUA agent; 'reasoning' = map nama-agent -> config (override default). Field 'reasoning' di tiap agent menang atas keduanya. Config: string "max" ATAU objek {"effort":"max|xhigh|high|medium|low|minimal|none", "max_tokens":N, "enabled":bool, "exclude":bool}. Prioritas: agent.reasoning > reasoning[nama] > default_reasoning > env HIJARKI_REASONING_EFFORT. CATATAN: hanya diterapkan pada model Claude/Fable/Opus-class (deteksi katalog/env CLAUDE_MODELS). Preserve reasoning_details (relay antar-agent) SELALU aktif bila model mengembalikannya.
